title: Parse and Transform Errors
goal: Chain trimming, string parsing, and error mapping in the correct order.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Error Handling

hints: The input starts as a raw string slice &str.
Clean whitespace first, parse into a Result second, and map any parsing error last.
explanation: `.parse::<u16>()` turns a `&str` into a `Result<u16, ParseIntError>`, and `?` unwraps it or returns the error. Without the turbofish the compiler cannot tell which numeric type you want.
